title: Chief of Staff / CEO office in a scale-up
why: You work directly on the CEO's priorities: strategy, board prep, special projects. Often open to ex-consulting interns and grads, and a common bridge into corporate strategy.
examples: French scale-ups listed on Welcome to the Jungle and Station F

title: Internal strategy consulting teams
why: Large groups run in-house consulting teams that hire like consulting firms but keep you inside one company, with good exit routes into strategy roles there.
examples: BNP Paribas CIB Consulting & Transformation (live offer in the Offers tab)

title: Open innovation and corporate venturing
why: Ties directly to your interest in open innovation: scouting start-ups, running partnerships and pilots for big corporates. You already applied to Impulse Partners in this space.
examples: Open-innovation consultancies and the venture arms of energy and automotive groups

title: Energy-transition strategy consulting
why: Strategy boutiques that only work on energy transition and climate. Your CSR ash-recovery project at AFOCO is a real talking point there.
examples: Enea Consulting, Carbone 4, energy practices of tier-2 firms

title: Pricing and commercial strategy
why: A strategy niche with heavy client contact in luxury, consumer and pharma. Lets you use your sales internship in Madrid alongside your strategy master.
examples: Simon-Kucher (live offer in the Offers tab)

title: Strategy for investors (commercial due diligence)
why: Strategy consulting for private-equity funds: market studies on short, intense deals. Good training and a route into PE value-creation roles.

title: VIE in a strategy or business-development team
why: 12–24 months abroad with a French group, tax-free allowance and real responsibility. Your Singapore and Australia experience makes you credible for Asia-Pacific posts.
examples: Euronext – Nord Pool Strategy Business Analyst VIE (Offers tab)

title: Rotational graduate programmes with a strategy track
why: You rotate through 2–3 roles before choosing, with one rotation in strategy. Safer bet than waiting for a single strategy opening.
examples: Renault Group (Strategy, Internal Consulting & Partnerships track)
